facts.fact: 拳袋疗法：Ben 陪练一小时，指关节破皮——她「对我发飙」的账全砸在沙袋上。
facts.anchor: You can tell me what happened.

facts.fact: 他的困局：她说用我用完就丢——「我就是想不明白为什么」。
facts.anchor: I’m just trying to figure out why.

facts.fact: 不收她辅导费的理由：见过她家人之后——不想把关系变成交易，结果两头落空。
facts.anchor: I didn’t want our relationship to become transactional.

facts.fact: 快递被拆：书稿打样摊在餐桌，妈妈的笑脸朝上——秘密曝光。
facts.anchor: The book is strewn open and Mum’s smile shines back up at me.

facts.fact: 书的献词页：献给所有做出最大牺牲的母亲们——她们不会被忘记。
facts.anchor: Dedicated to the mothers everywhere, who made the greatest sacrifice.

facts.fact: 最重的一页：妈妈日记末行「等这一切结束就回去见我的男孩们」——写完两天后殉职，死于战地报道。
facts.anchor: Two days after that was written she was dead. Killed in action reporting on the war.

facts.fact: 全家最后一张完整合照：机场国际出发口——Dad 无皱纹、Jason 无眼后阴影、Oliver 笑得最亮。
facts.anchor: outside international departures at the airport when Mum left on one of her earlier missions.

facts.fact: 父母相遇的方式：她卧底调查一个犯罪集团——头目恰好与他们同姓。
facts.anchor: investigating a criminal syndicate where the ringleader shared a last name with us.

facts.fact: 通宵粘便签后：爸爸永远无法完全理解他，但他理解了妈妈——「那就够了」；当晚睡了几个月来最好的一觉。
facts.anchor: he understood my mother. And that’s enough.

facts.fact: 醉酒吧错认：眼镜框太黑、鼻梁太直、脸颊没有雀斑——不是 Eden。
facts.anchor: Her glasses frames are too dark, her nose is a bit too straight.
